subject: On-demand admin-event 'slab' exports and attestable delivery for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@verdanthealth.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: compact admin-event exports for upcoming SOC 2 evidence review

Hi Jordan & Vanessa,

We’re preparing materials for an external assessor next week and need a self-contained slice of admin activity covering the period Jan 1–Mar 25, 2028. Our scope request:

- All admin-level events (creates, updates, deletes) for identities with admin, infra, and security roles.
- Include actor, target resource, event_type, timestamp (UTC), IP, session_id/KV-cache references where available.
- Prefer deltas per user (chronological slab) instead of full live tables; assessor wants reproducible ordering.

Can Redwood produce an on-demand extract that:
1) can be limited to admin role filters + time window,
2) is delivered as compressed newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) + CSV manifest, and
3) includes a SHA256 checksum per file and an overall signed manifest for chain-of-custody?

Also let us know retention metadata included in the export (original retention policy and last-modified stamps), and any recommended redaction steps for PII before delivery.

We’re under a tight timeline — assessor kickoff Fri morning PST. Can you confirm feasibility and ETA?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reyes
Security Manager, Verdant Health
compliance+audit@verdanthealth.io

---
Attachment: request_scope_verdant_20280325.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@verdanthealth.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: compact admin-event exports for upcoming SOC 2 evidence review

Tom — thanks for the clear scope. We can produce slab exports that match the constraints you outlined. A few clarifications so we deliver exactly what the assessor expects:

1) "Admin-level events" — do you want us to include systemic operator/service accounts (e.g., deploy-bot, data-sync) or only human principals?
2) For KV-cache references/session ids: we can include them but can redact KV contents; is including session_id sufficient for traceability?
3) Signed manifest: we can supply a gzipped ndjson bundle + a signed manifest (SHA256) and an optional notarized timestamp (we use an HSM-based signing key for evidence). Is that acceptable?

Tentative ETA: if you confirm the above by EOD today we can provide a first pass export by Thu 18:00 PST and final attestable bundle by Fri 09:00 PST. Vanessa, looping you for export packaging and transport (SFTP vs encrypted Drive share) — any preferences for transfer method with Verdant?

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: none

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: compact admin-event exports for upcoming SOC 2 evidence review

Quick technical note / proposed export spec (attaching PDF):

- File layout: a series of compressed files named slab_000001.ndjson.gz .. slab_00000N.ndjson.gz (each <= 2GB uncompressed), plus a manifest CSV that lists file_name, record_count, first_ts_utc, last_ts_utc, sha256.
- Record schema (ndjson): {timestamp_utc, actor_type, actor_id, actor_email, role_label, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_address, session_id, request_id, meta_flags} — we'll include only the meta_flags names, not intrinsic secrets.
- PII redaction: default policy is to redact full email addresses for service accounts and mask user emails to user_hash unless Verdant requests exact emails. We can provide a mapping table in a separate secure artifact if required by legal.
- Retention/lineage: each record includes original_log_partition and ingestion_offset so the assessor can verify the extract came from production streams.
- Attestation: we will produce per-file SHA256 and a signed manifest (PKCS#7 signature). We can also notarize timestamp with our HSM-backed signing process (this creates an audit token file).

Transport options:
- Preferred: SFTP+keypair from your side (we push the encrypted bundle and signature).
- Alternate: Encrypted Google Drive share with restricted access and retention-limited link.

I attached a short export_spec_v1.pdf with the example fields and an exported manifest template. If you need CSV instead of ndjson we can convert in pipeline.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: export_spec_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@verdanthealth.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: compact admin-event exports for upcoming SOC 2 evidence review

Jordan / Vanessa / Markus — this looks good and exactly like what the assessor asked for. Answers:
- Include human principals only (exclude deploy-bot entries).
- Session_id is sufficient; no KV contents needed.
- HSM-signed manifest + SHA256 per file is required.

We prefer SFTP pickup. Please push to sftp.verdanthealth.io (credentials will be shared by our IT ticket). If you can target Thu 18:00 PST for the first pass that allows our internal reviewer to sanity-check before Fri.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom
Tom Reyes
Security Manager, Verdant Health
